plan.summary: Death of a Salesman capitalization $8M as reported by the NYT (2026-06-08); keep the Form D as a source

actions.oldValue: The Hollywood Reporter (Aug 11, 2026): "the play, which was capitalized for up to $8.9 million, has not announced recoupment after playing its final performance Aug. 9." https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/broadway-box-office-death-salesman-cats-the-jellicle-ball-1236671126/
actions.newValue: The New York Times (Jun 8, 2026): "some 'Salesman' investors are frustrated that the show, capitalized for $8 million, has not recouped its capitalization costs yet; members of the producing team say they expect it will do so." https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/08/theater/scott-rudin-salesman-tony-awards.html The SEC Form D (Loman Broadway Ltd Liability Co, signed Feb 3, 2026) set the offering ceiling at $8,900,000, which The Hollywood Reporter (Aug 11, 2026) repeated as "capitalized for up to $8.9 million."

actions.oldValue: Revival produced by Scott Rudin, Barry Diller and Roy Furman; opened Apr 9, 2026 and closed Aug 9, 2026, grossing about $36.9M. Capitalized for up to $8.9 million. The Hollywood Reporter noted after closing that no recoupment had been announced (these producers typically do not announce one). A BroadwayWorld forum poster estimated in June that it was about three weeks from recouping; that is a guess, not a report. Its SEC Form D (Loman Broadway Ltd Liability Co, CIK 0002107826, signed Feb 3, 2026) offered $8,900,000 with $0 sold at filing, before the first sale: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2107826/000210782626000001/xslFormDX01/primary_doc.xml
